maria_cs: Quick heads-up — BrightArc (pilot) asked for NYC edge peering + a temporary QPS bump for onboarding tomorrow. They want a burst to 120 qps for ~6h (start 11:00 ET). Need IP allowlist + routing. Any concerns?
sam_se: Ack, we can do region routing to nyc-edge and add CIDRs to the org allowlist. Need the customer CIDRs and cert thumbprint for peering handshake. Also will need an org-scoped ratelimit override. Ping @raj_sre for the peering side.
brightarc-sre: FYI — we'll post CIDRs in a sec. Also prefer window 11:00-17:00 ET so their SRE can shadow.
raj_sre: Sounds fine. For peering: I'll provision the ACL and route. Please confirm CIDRs and the contact email for the peering handshake. Prefer we do the peering change during the stated window and have rollback steps ready.
maria_cs: CIDRs from customer: `34.210.12.0/24`, `3.87.44.0/24`. Contact: ops@brightarc.com. Sending cert thumbprint via DM. Requested start 2026-03-25 11:00 ET.
sam_se: Got the CIDRs and thumbprint. I'll open the infra change and set the temporary override. Planned command (will run from infra job): `redwoodctl org update-ratelimit --org=brightarc-org-id --qps=120 --until=2026-03-25T17:00:00-04:00` — canary in staging first at 09:00 ET.
deploy-bot: chore/infra #4521 created by sam_se: Add BrightArc CIDRs and temp QPS override. ETA: 2h for change rollout. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4521
liz_am: Noted. I'll run the onboarding kickoff at 11:15 ET and capture enablement feedback. Also flagging account for renewal outreach — their renewal is ~30 days out and increased usage may affect commercial terms.
sam_se: :thumbsup: I'll monitor latency and token cost impact during the window. If we see token spikes or tail latency, we'll start throttling back to 40 qps and notify. @raj_sre please approve peering once CI passes.
raj_sre: Approve on my end — will apply ACLs after the PR merges and run health checks. Adding temporary circuit limits and keep-alive probe.
maria_cs: Thanks team. DM me rollout logs and any anomalies; I'll coordinate with BrightArc ops. If anything goes sideways revert to baseline 20 qps.
deploy-bot: deploy status: PR merged, infra job started, rollout 0/3 nodes updated. Will post updates every 5m.
